event_name: Date 29 April 2018 Time 17:28 2018 AZERBAIJAN GRAND PRIX 26 - 29 April 2018 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 35 collided with car 11 in turn 2.
offence: Causing a collision in breach of Article 2d of Chapter IV, Appendix L of the FIA International Sporting Code.
penalty: 3 grid position penalty at the driver's next event (2 penalty points awarded, 2 points in total for the 12 month period)
reason: The Stewards examined video evidence. The driver of car 35 drove into the back of car 11. The Stewards determined that the driver of car 9 was wholly to blame for the collision. Garry Connelly Dennis Dean Tom Kristensen Anar Shukurov
